recipes.editInstruction: Remove all ground: erase the grass and the brown soil slab under the camp, so the tents, the totem pole, the flag and the standing stones stand directly on a transparent background with nothing at all under them. Keep the bright red cone tents with their cream tusks, the cream bone totem with its skull, the bright red banner flag, the dark standing stones, the outline and the art style exactly the same.
recipes.notes: dinosaur-city-1-a is the right small camp (three red cone tents over cream tusks, a bone totem with a horned skull, a red banner, basalt stones, 27.7% owner area, QA pass) on a grass and soil slab.

recipes.editInstruction: Paint the whole roof of the cream hut on the left plain flat bright red, and recolour the small dark brown hut behind the skull on the right to plain flat bright red hide. Change nothing else: keep the giant cream rib arch, the horned skull, the bright red awning behind it, the bright red cone tents, the dark stone posts, the outline and the art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
recipes.notes: dinosaur-city-3-a-edit-3 turned the hut to cream hide but its red roof went with it: 16.6% owner area, less than City 2. A single-focus edit gives the hut roof and the small hut behind the skull back to the owner colour.
